  chunk_output_type: console

```{r}
### GLOBAL REGIONAL MARKER DOT PLOT

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

output_dir <- "01_6_global regional marker dot plot"

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

```


```{r}
### SETTINGS

top_markers_per_region <- 2L

marker_min_pct <- 0.10
marker_log2fc_cutoff <- 0.25
marker_min_pct_difference <- 0.10
```


```{r}
### PREPARE OBJECT

DefaultAssay(
  experiment
) <- "Spatial"


cells_use <- rownames(
  experiment@meta.data
)[
  !is.na(
    experiment$labels
  ) &
    experiment$labels != "n/a"
]


experiment_regions <- subset(
  experiment,
  cells = cells_use
)


### Preserve the existing anatomical-region order when labels
### are already stored as a factor.

if (
  is.factor(
    experiment_regions$labels
  )
) {

  region_order <- levels(
    droplevels(
      experiment_regions$labels
    )
  )

} else {

  region_order <- unique(
    as.character(
      experiment_regions$labels
    )
  )
}


experiment_regions$labels <- factor(
  experiment_regions$labels,
  levels = region_order
)


Idents(
  experiment_regions
) <- "labels"

```


```{r}
### REGION-VERSUS-REST MARKER ANALYSIS

region_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  object = experiment_regions,

  assay = "Spatial",

  only.pos = TRUE,

  test.use = "wilcox",

  min.pct = marker_min_pct,

  logfc.threshold =
    marker_log2fc_cutoff,

  return.thresh = 1,

  verbose = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
### RANK MARKERS BY REGIONAL SEPARATION

region_markers_ranked <- region_markers %>%
  mutate(
    region = as.character(
      cluster
    ),

    pct_difference =
      pct.1 - pct.2,

    marker_score =
      avg_log2FC *
      pct_difference
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(
      p_val_adj
    ),

    p_val_adj < 0.05,

    avg_log2FC >
      marker_log2fc_cutoff,

    pct.1 >=
      marker_min_pct,

    pct_difference >=
      marker_min_pct_difference,

    !grepl(
      pattern = "^(mt-|Rpl|Rps)",
      x = gene
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    region = factor(
      region,
      levels = region_order
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    region,
    desc(
      marker_score
    ),
    desc(
      avg_log2FC
    ),
    desc(
      pct_difference
    )
  )
```


```{r}
### SELECT DISTINCT TOP MARKERS

# A gene is used only once in the plot, even if it ranks
# highly for more than one anatomical region.

selected_marker_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(
    region_order
  )
)


used_genes <- character()


for (
  region_index in seq_along(
    region_order
  )
) {

  current_region <-
    region_order[
      region_index
    ]


  current_candidates <-
    region_markers_ranked %>%
    filter(
      as.character(
        region
      ) == current_region,

      !gene %in%
        used_genes
    ) %>%

    slice_head(
      n = top_markers_per_region
    )


  selected_marker_list[[
    region_index
  ]] <- current_candidates


  used_genes <- c(
    used_genes,
    current_candidates$gene
  )
}


top_region_markers <- bind_rows(
  selected_marker_list
) %>%
  mutate(
    region = factor(
      region,
      levels = region_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    region,
    desc(
      marker_score
    )
  )


write.csv(
  top_region_markers,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "top_region_separating_markers.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Check whether every region obtained the requested number.

marker_count_by_region <- top_region_markers %>%
  dplyr::count(
    region,
    name = "n_selected_markers"
  )


print(
  marker_count_by_region,
  row.names = FALSE
)

```

```{r}
### CLUSTER REGIONS BY SELECTED-MARKER EXPRESSION

# Use the same selected markers that will be shown in the
# final dot plot.

selected_marker_genes <- unique(
  top_region_markers$gene
)


# Obtain scaled average expression for every selected marker
# in every anatomical region.

marker_clustering_data <- Seurat::DotPlot(
  object = experiment_regions,

  features = selected_marker_genes,

  assay = "Spatial",

  group.by = "labels",

  scale = TRUE
)$data %>%

  dplyr::transmute(
    region = as.character(
      id
    ),

    gene = as.character(
      features.plot
    ),

    scaled_average_expression =
      avg.exp.scaled
  ) %>%

  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = gene,
    values_from = scaled_average_expression
  )


# Convert to a region × marker matrix.

marker_clustering_matrix <- as.data.frame(
  marker_clustering_data
)


rownames(
  marker_clustering_matrix
) <- marker_clustering_matrix$region


marker_clustering_matrix$region <- NULL


marker_clustering_matrix <- as.matrix(
  marker_clustering_matrix
)


# Ensure that all annotated regions are represented.

missing_clustering_regions <- setdiff(
  region_order,
  rownames(
    marker_clustering_matrix
  )
)


if (
  length(
    missing_clustering_regions
  ) > 0
) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "The marker-expression matrix is missing these regions: ",
      paste(
        missing_clustering_regions,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


# Start from the complete original region set.

marker_clustering_matrix <-
  marker_clustering_matrix[
    region_order,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


# Remove marker columns containing non-finite scaled values.

finite_marker_columns <- apply(
  marker_clustering_matrix,
  2,
  function(x) {
    all(
      is.finite(
        x
      )
    )
  }
)


if (
  any(
    !finite_marker_columns
  )
) {

  warning(
    paste0(
      "Removing ",
      sum(
        !finite_marker_columns
      ),
      " marker genes with non-finite scaled expression values."
    )
  )


  marker_clustering_matrix <-
    marker_clustering_matrix[
      ,
      finite_marker_columns,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
}


if (
  ncol(
    marker_clustering_matrix
  ) < 2
) {

  stop(
    "Too few marker genes remain for regional clustering."
  )
}


# Cluster regions using their scaled expression profiles
# across all selected markers.

region_marker_distance <- stats::dist(
  marker_clustering_matrix,
  method = "euclidean"
)


region_marker_hclust <- stats::hclust(
  region_marker_distance,
  method = "average"
)


region_order_clustered <- rownames(
  marker_clustering_matrix
)[
  region_marker_hclust$order
]


# Save the resulting order for documentation.

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    plot_position = seq_along(
      region_order_clustered
    ),

    region =
      region_order_clustered
  ),

  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "anatomical_region_marker_clustered_order.csv"
  ),

  row.names = FALSE
)


print(
  data.frame(
    plot_position = seq_along(
      region_order_clustered
    ),

    region =
      region_order_clustered
  ),

  row.names = FALSE
)


# Apply the same order to the regional identities shown on
# the dot-plot y-axis.

experiment_regions$labels <- factor(
  as.character(
    experiment_regions$labels
  ),
  levels = region_order_clustered
)


Idents(
  experiment_regions
) <- "labels"
```


```{r}
### CONSTRUCT CLUSTER-ORDERED FEATURE LIST

# Order the marker blocks according to the clustered regional
# order. Within each block, retain the marker-score ranking.

top_region_markers_plot <- top_region_markers %>%
  mutate(
    region = factor(
      as.character(
        region
      ),
      levels = region_order_clustered
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    region,
    desc(
      marker_score
    )
  )


marker_feature_list <- split(
  top_region_markers_plot$gene,
  top_region_markers_plot$region,
  drop = TRUE
)


### Explicitly enforce the same order as the region identities.

marker_feature_list <-
  marker_feature_list[
    region_order_clustered[
      region_order_clustered %in%
        names(
          marker_feature_list
        )
    ]
  ]

```

```{r}
### GENERATE REGIONAL MARKER DOT PLOT


# Prepare marker order

marker_order_table <- top_region_markers %>%
  mutate(
    region = as.character(
      region
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    factor(
      region,
      levels = region_order
    ),
    desc(
      marker_score
    )
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    gene,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    marker_region = factor(
      region,
      levels = region_order
    )
  )


marker_genes <- marker_order_table$gene



# Extract Seurat dotplot data

regional_marker_plot_data <- Seurat::DotPlot(
  object = experiment_regions,

  features = marker_genes,

  assay = "Spatial",

  group.by = "labels",

  scale = TRUE
)$data %>%

  transmute(
    region = as.character(
      id
    ),

    gene = as.character(
      features.plot
    ),

    percent_expressed =
      pct.exp,

    average_expression_scaled =
      avg.exp.scaled
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    marker_order_table %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene,
        marker_region,
        marker_score
      ),

    by = "gene"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    region = factor(
      region,
      levels = region_order
    ),

    marker_region = factor(
      as.character(
        marker_region
      ),
      levels = region_order
    ),

    gene = factor(
      gene,
      levels = rev(
        marker_genes
      )
    )
  )



# Split marker groups into two balanced panels

split_position <- ceiling(
  length(
    region_order
  ) / 2
)


marker_region_sets <- list(
  region_order[
    seq_len(
      split_position
    )
  ],

  region_order[
    seq.int(
      split_position + 1,
      length(
        region_order
      )
    )
  ]
)



# Panel function

make_regional_marker_panel <- function(
  marker_regions
) {

  current_plot_data <- regional_marker_plot_data %>%
    filter(
      as.character(
        marker_region
      ) %in% marker_regions
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      marker_region = factor(
        as.character(
          marker_region
        ),
        levels = marker_regions
      )
    )


  ggplot(
    current_plot_data,
    aes(
      x = region,
      y = gene
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = percent_expressed,
        colour = average_expression_scaled
      )
    ) +

    facet_grid(
      rows = vars(
        marker_region
      ),

      scales = "free_y",
      space = "free_y",
      switch = "y"
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Percent\nexpressed",

      limits = c(
        0,
        100
      ),

      breaks = c(
        0,
        25,
        50,
        75,
        100
      ),

      range = c(
        0,
        5
      )
    ) +

    scale_colour_gradient(
      name = "Scaled average\nexpression",

      low = "grey92",
      high = "#b2182b",

      limits = c(
        -1,
        2
      ),

      breaks = c(
        -1,
        0,
        1,
        2
      ),

      oob = scales::squish
    ) +

    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme_bw() +

    theme(
      panel.grid =
        element_blank(),

      panel.border =
        element_rect(
          colour = "grey80",
          linewidth = 0.3
        ),

      panel.spacing.y =
        grid::unit(
          0.08,
          "lines"
        ),

      strip.placement =
        "outside",

      strip.background =
        element_rect(
          fill = "grey92",
          colour = "grey60",
          linewidth = 0.3
        ),

      strip.text.y =
        element_text(
          angle = 0,
          face = "bold",
          size = 7
        ),

      strip.text.y.left =
        element_text(
          angle = 0,
          face = "bold",
          size = 7
        ),

      axis.text.x =
        element_text(
          angle = 45,
          hjust = 1,
          vjust = 1,
          size = 7
        ),

      axis.text.y =
        element_text(
          face = "italic",
          size = 7
        ),

      axis.ticks =
        element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "right"
    )
}



# Generate and combine panels

regional_marker_panel_1 <-
  make_regional_marker_panel(
    marker_region_sets[[1]]
  )


regional_marker_panel_2 <-
  make_regional_marker_panel(
    marker_region_sets[[2]]
  )


regional_marker_dotplot <-
  regional_marker_panel_1 +
  regional_marker_panel_2 +

  patchwork::plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    widths = c(
      1,
      1
    )
  ) +

  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title =
      "Transcriptional markers distinguishing anatomical regions",

    subtitle = paste0(
      "Top ",
      top_markers_per_region,
      " positive region-versus-rest markers per region"
    ),

    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 15
      ),

      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10
      )
    )
  )


regional_marker_dotplot <-
  regional_marker_dotplot &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )


regional_marker_dotplot



# Save

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "global_anatomical_region_marker_dotplot_optimized.pdf"
  ),

  plot = regional_marker_dotplot,

  device = cairo_pdf,

  width = 18,
  height = 12.5,
  units = "in"
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "global_anatomical_region_marker_dotplot_optimized.png"
  ),

  plot = regional_marker_dotplot,

  width = 18,
  height = 12.5,
  units = "in",

  dpi = 300
)
```
